fact: PROCASEF's steering committee records that SIFCOM development is complete and the system is in its deployment phase, with 55 communes integrated in preproduction at 30 June 2026.
PROCASEF reports 10,318 titres d'affectation approved in the NICAD system were handed over in Dodel commune, with a land office and SIFCOM still to be deployed there.
PROCASEF states that 128 land offices were built and equipped with the SIFCOM communal land information system, and that 583,052 parcels carried a NICAD by March 2026.
The World Bank says SIFCOM's modules are mainly validated with deployment postponed to end-December 2025, and that land office construction is underway in 128 of 138 municipalities.
The World Bank reports 351,899 occupancy titles with NICAD recorded in the Land Information System at 21 November 2025, and zero municipal land bureaux yet equipped and operational with LIS access.

allAfrica reports the DGID awarded the contract for the SGF, an integrated land management platform with a cadastral GIS module, to ModelSis in December 2023 for an 18-month build, and describes it as still in gestation in December 2025.

PROCASEF coordinator Mouhamadou Moustapha Dia says over 830,000 parcels are mapped in 138 communes, 630,000 have cadastral numbers, and 128 communal land offices are built to host the SIFCOM digital land information system.

A PROCASEF information-systems manager told APS on 16 April 2026 that a system to digitise the whole communal land procedure, from request to title, with applicants able to track their file on the platform, is in a deployment phase and agents were being trained in Thiès.

PROCASEF reports that SIFCOM is planned to be operational in the 136 communal land offices of the project, and that an electronic land book is announced to replace paper registers in the land conservation offices.

Le Soleil reports that the DGID's Pagcf project runs Suigil 2, a web and Android platform to centralise cadastral data and issue tax notices, which after a 2021-2024 pilot added over 38,000 parcels to the tax database in the pilot zones; the Cadastre director says no exhaustive cadastre covers the whole country.
